title: Borrower concentration

coverage.note: Shares are fair-value-weighted; the denominator each quarter is that quarter's total position fair value, which ties to the filed total_investments_fv within 0.01%. Borrowers are grouped on the raw borrower string, which is internally consistent within a quarter but is not reconciled across quarters, so a borrower renamed between filings would be double-counted. Plotted on the full 32-quarter calendar; 2019Q3 and 2022Q1 are breaks.
